papers.title: Chronic evoked seizures differentially worsen cognitive function and long-term neuropsychiatric comorbidities in Alzheimer's disease-related genotypes
papers.translated_title: 慢性诱发性癫痫发作对阿尔茨海默病相关基因型中的认知功能和长期神经精神共病具有差异性恶化作用
papers.author: Knox, K.
papers.summary: Variants in one of three deterministic risk genes - amyloid precursor protein (APP), presenilin 1 (PSEN1), or presenilin 2 (PSEN2) - lead to early-onset Alzheimer's disease (EOAD), which also carries a high risk of spontaneous seizures. Seizures may worsen AD-related behavioral comorbidities, including depression, anxiety, and cognitive impairment. Using the corneal kindling model of secondarily generalized focal seizures in two distinct aged male and female EOAD-associated mouse models, we assessed the interaction between investigator-initiated chronic seizures and EOAD genotype on AD-related behavioral comorbidities. Genotypes were selected to model amyloid-b; independent and dependent AD risk factors and included: PSEN2-N141I (amyloid-b; independent model) versus wild-type (PSEN2 control) mice, and APP/PS1 (amyloid-b dependent model) versus wild-type littermates (Tg-). Sham and fully kindled mice then underwent behavioral assessment in the saccharin preference test of anhedonia-like behavior, the Barnes maze test of spatial learning and memory, and a 67-hour home cage monitoring of circadian activity. EOAD genotype only significantly affected kindling acquisition of aged APP/PS1 females. However, there was no significant genotype or kindling effect on saccharin preference, suggesting no adverse impact on anhedonia-like behavior. Cognitive performance in the Barnes maze was significantly worsened by seizures exclusively in APP/PS1 female mice. However, seizures generally worsened Barnes maze performance of male PSEN2-N141I and PSEN2 control mice. Finally, chronic seizures consistently worsened exploratory behavior patterns during home cage circadian activity monitoring exclusively in APP/PS1 male and female mice. This study reveals the AD-related heterogeneity of seizure-evoked behavioral consequences on spatial working memory and circadian behaviors.
papers.translated_summary: 三个确定性风险基因——淀粉样前体蛋白（APP）、早老素1（PSEN1）或早老素2（PSEN2）——中的任一基因变异均可导致早发性阿尔茨海默病（EOAD），该病同时具有自发性癫痫发作的高风险。癫痫发作可能加重AD相关的行为共病，包括抑郁、焦虑和认知障碍。本研究采用角膜点燃模型诱导继发性全面性局灶性癫痫发作，在两种不同的老年雄性和雌性EOAD相关小鼠模型中，评估研究者诱发的慢性癫痫发作与EOAD基因型之间的交互作用对AD相关行为共病的影响。基因型的选择旨在模拟淀粉样蛋白β非依赖性和依赖性的AD风险因素，包括：PSEN2-N141I（淀粉样蛋白β非依赖模型）与野生型（PSEN2对照）小鼠，以及APP/PS1（淀粉样蛋白β依赖模型）与野生型同窝对照（Tg-）小鼠。假点燃组和完全点燃组小鼠随后接受行为学评估，包括糖精偏好测试（快感缺失样行为）、Barnes迷宫测试（空间学习与记忆）以及67小时家庭笼昼夜活动监测。EOAD基因型仅显著影响老年APP/PS1雌性小鼠的点燃获得过程。然而，基因型或点燃对糖精偏好均无显著影响，提示对快感缺失样行为无不良影响。Barnes迷宫中的认知表现仅在接受癫痫发作的APP/PS1雌性小鼠中显著恶化。然而，癫痫发作普遍恶化了雄性PSEN2-N141I和PSEN2对照小鼠的Barnes迷宫表现。最后，慢性癫痫发作一致性地恶化了家庭笼昼夜活动监测中的探索行为模式，且这一效应仅见于APP/PS1雄性和雌性小鼠。本研究揭示了癫痫发作诱发的空间工作记忆和昼夜行为行为后果在AD相关方面的异质性。

papers.title: Identification of a human Anxa1-associated dopaminergic population linked to Parkinson's disease vulnerability and sensorimotor putaminal networks
papers.translated_title: 人类Anxa1相关多巴胺能群体的鉴定及其与帕金森病易感性和感觉运动壳核网络的关联
papers.author: Schonfeld, E.
papers.summary: The selective loss of dopaminergic (DA) neurons drives motor symptoms of Parkinson's disease (PD). In mice, Anxa1+ SNc DA neurons are highly vulnerable in PD models, project to the dorsolateral striatum, and display movement-correlated activity, yet they lack clearly defined human counterparts. We transfer the mouse taxonomy to human using a hierarchical mixture-of-experts model, recovering a human Anxa1-associated population. We find that this was the most depleted subtype in PD brains. A ligand-receptor algorithm, validated against mouse tracing, infers that these neurons preferentially innervate the caudal putamen. There, DaT-SPECT shows the earliest and most severe DA axon loss in PD. Functional connectivity positions this region as a critical node within the somato-cognitive action network, linking DA neuron vulnerability to circuit dysfunction. To translate these insights, we present an interactive portal unifying human datasets with a cross-species FDA Drug Atlas, nominating CACNA1G as a candidate neuroprotective target for the Anxa1-associated population.
papers.translated_summary: 多巴胺能（DA）神经元的选择性丢失驱动帕金森病（PD）的运动症状。在小鼠中，Anxa1+ SNc DA神经元在PD模型中高度脆弱，投射至背外侧纹状体，并表现出与运动相关的活动，但它们缺乏明确界定的人类对应物。我们使用分层混合专家模型将小鼠分类学转移至人类，恢复出一个人类Anxa1相关群体。我们发现这是PD大脑中耗竭最严重的亚型。一种配体-受体算法经小鼠示踪验证，推断这些神经元优先支配尾侧壳核。在该区域，DaT-SPECT显示PD中最早且最严重的DA轴突丢失。功能连接将该区域定位为躯体-认知行动网络中的关键节点，将DA神经元脆弱性与环路功能障碍联系起来。为转化这些见解，我们呈现一个交互式门户，将人类数据集与跨物种FDA药物图谱统一起来，提名CACNA1G作为Anxa1相关群体的候选神经保护靶点。

papers.title: The language network responds stronger to connected than to unconnected sentences
papers.translated_title: 语言网络对连贯句子的反应比对不连贯句子的反应更强
papers.author: Paliga, F.
papers.summary: Purpose: Reliable functional mapping of the language network and preoperative assessment of language lateralization are essential for safe and effective craniotomy in patients with lesions in language-eloquent brain regions, yet existing fMRI language paradigms are often time-consuming and place substantial cognitive and economic demands on patients and diagnostic services. Methods: We therefore tested ecologically valid German stimulus sets designed to optimize measurement efficiency. Forty-three healthy participants (mean age = 38 years, range = 20 - 64; 24 women) were scanned on a 3T MRI while reading or listening to 4-, 8-, and 12-word sentences and pseudoword lists or texts, each followed by a decision task. Sentences were selected from German literary classics and text passages from general-interest science magazines and matched across conditions for lexical and structural properties. Results: Region-of-interest analyses in subject-specific, functionally defined language-sensitive regions showed robust activation of the left-hemispheric language network across modalities. Within participants, texts elicited significantly larger effect sizes than sentences, and longer sentences generally produced stronger responses than shorter ones. Task manipulations expected to increase cognitive demand (short 4-word sentences with frequent probes, coherent texts requiring deeper semantic integration) did not enhance responses in the domain-general multiple demand network, indicating that executive-control activity did not overshadow language-selective activation, whereas substantial overlap between default mode and language-sensitive regions in the left temporal lobe was consistent with relatively automatic processing of connected language. Conclusions: These findings indicate that ecologically valid sentence- and text-based paradigms can provide efficient, language-specific fMRI protocols for preoperative diagnostics and individualized presurgical planning in patients with lesions near language-eloquent cortex.
papers.translated_summary: 目的：可靠的语言网络功能定位和术前语言偏侧化评估对于语言功能区病变患者的安全有效开颅手术至关重要，然而现有的fMRI语言范式往往耗时较长，并对患者和诊断服务造成较大的认知和经济负担。方法：因此，我们测试了生态有效的德语刺激集，旨在优化测量效率。43名健康参与者（平均年龄=38岁，范围=20-64岁；24名女性）在3T MRI上接受扫描，期间阅读或聆听4词、8词和12词句子及假词列表或文本，每项任务后跟随一个判断任务。句子选自德国文学经典，文本段落选自大众兴趣科学杂志，并在各条件间对词汇和结构属性进行了匹配。结果：在被试特异性、功能定义的语言敏感区域进行感兴趣区分析显示，左半球语言网络在各模态下均出现稳健激活。在被试内，文本引发的效应量显著大于句子，较长的句子通常比较短的句子产生更强的反应。预期增加认知需求的任务操作（带有频繁探测的短4词句子、需要更深语义整合的连贯文本）并未增强域一般多重需求网络的反应，表明执行控制活动未掩盖语言选择性激活，而左颞叶默认模式区域与语言敏感区域之间的显著重叠与连贯语言的相对自动加工相一致。结论：这些发现表明，生态有效的句子和文本范式可为语言功能区皮层附近病变患者的术前诊断和个体化术前规划提供高效、语言特异性的fMRI方案。

papers.title: Preparatory beta activity reflects the precision demands of an upcoming movement
papers.translated_title: 预备性β活动反映了即将发生的动作对精确度的要求
papers.author: Delisle-Godin, D.
papers.summary: Noise and external disturbances continuously push the limb away from its intended path, but not every deviation compromises the goal of an action. The accuracy constraints of a task define the range of acceptable endpoints and thereby set its precision demands, that is, how much noise must be attenuated for the task to succeed. Whether neural activity during movement preparation reflects these precision demands remains largely unexplored. We recorded electroencephalography (EEG) while healthy human participants (n = 27) prepared reaching movements toward narrow or wide targets at the same location and with the same timing constraints. An instructed delay before the go cue allowed preparatory activity to be isolated, and mechanical perturbations were applied during movement to probe feedback responses. Narrow targets led to more precise movements, with greater endpoint accuracy, lower variability and smaller perturbation-induced deviations. This was achieved without a reduction in movement speed, and involved greater muscle co-activation and larger long-latency responses to perturbations. Before movement onset, beta power (13-30 Hz) was lower for narrow than for wide targets, an effect that emerged late in the delay period and was concentrated over bilateral parieto-occipital electrodes. In contrast, alpha (8-12 Hz) and theta (4-7 Hz) activity did not differ between conditions. These findings demonstrate that preparatory beta activity is sensitive not only to kinematic requirements of the movement but also the precision with which it must be produced.
papers.translated_summary: 噪声和外部扰动不断使肢体偏离其预定路径，但并非每一次偏差都会损害动作的目标。任务的精度约束定义了可接受终点的范围，从而设定了其精度需求，即为使任务成功需要衰减多少噪声。运动准备期间的神经活动是否反映这些精度需求，在很大程度上仍未被探索。我们记录了健康人类参与者（n = 27）的脑电图（EEG），他们在相同位置、相同时间约束下准备朝向窄目标或宽目标的伸够运动。在提示信号之前的指令延迟使准备性活动得以被分离，并在运动期间施加机械扰动以探测反馈反应。窄目标导致更精确的运动，具有更高的终点精度、更低的变异性和更小的扰动诱发偏差。这是在运动速度未降低的情况下实现的，并涉及更大的肌肉共激活和对扰动的更大长潜伏期反应。在运动开始之前，窄目标的beta功率（13-30 Hz）低于宽目标，该效应在延迟期后期出现，并集中于双侧顶枕电极。相比之下，alpha（8-12 Hz）和theta（4-7 Hz）活动在两种条件之间没有差异。这些发现表明，准备性beta活动不仅对运动的运动学要求敏感，而且对其必须被产生的精度也敏感。

papers.title: Intranasal oxytocin increases early tactile engagement with a robotic dog: A within-session effect without consolidation
papers.translated_title: 鼻内催产素增加与机器狗的早期触觉互动：一种无巩固的会话内效应
papers.author: Aydin, S.
papers.summary: Oxytocin (OXT) is centrally involved in mammalian affiliation, but whether it modulates affiliative behavior toward artificial social agents, and how such an effect unfolds within a single interaction, is unclear. In a randomized, double-blind, placebo (PLA)-controlled study, 61 healthy adult males received 40 IU intranasal OXT or PLA before interacting with a Sony aibo robotic dog across an initial free interaction, a cooperative task-learning phase, and a final free interaction, with ten affiliative behaviors coded from video. OXT increased tactile engagement early: participants touched aibo longer during the initial free interaction, the only outcome of ten to survive family-wise correction. A weaker increase in smile frequency did not survive correction, and instrumental behavior was unaffected. Contrary to our second prediction, the advantage was not consolidated: it held through the initial interaction, closed across the intervening task, and was absent at the final one. An exploratory decomposition located the effect: participants under OXT did not initiate contact more often, and the difference was carried by how long each episode of contact was sustained. Urinary OXT confirmed group-level exposure. Because the design included no comparison condition and confounded interaction period with elapsed time and pharmacokinetics, it cannot establish bond formation, robot specificity, or consolidation as a psychological process. What it does bound is where and when OXT acted: on the maintenance of contact rather than its initiation, and only while the agent was novel, a pattern that fits salience- and novelty-based accounts better than bond formation.
papers.translated_summary: 催产素（OXT）在哺乳动物的亲社会联结中发挥核心作用，但它是否调节对人工社会主体的亲和行为，以及这种效应在单次互动中如何展开，尚不清楚。在一项随机、双盲、安慰剂（PLA）对照研究中，61名健康成年男性在与索尼aibo机器狗互动前接受40 IU鼻内OXT或PLA，互动包括初始自由互动、合作任务学习阶段和最终自由互动，并从视频中编码十种亲和行为。OXT在早期增加了触觉参与：参与者在初始自由互动中触摸aibo的时间更长，这是十项结果中唯一经家庭wise校正后仍显著的结果。微笑频率的较弱增加未通过校正，工具性行为未受影响。与我们的第二个预测相反，该优势并未得到巩固：它在初始互动中持续存在，在中间任务期间消失，在最终互动中不存在。一项探索性分解定位了该效应：接受OXT的参与者并未更频繁地发起接触，差异由每次接触 episode 的持续时间所承载。尿液OXT证实了组水平暴露。由于设计未包含对照条件，且将互动时段与流逝时间和药代动力学相混淆，它无法确立联结形成、机器人特异性或巩固作为一种心理过程。它所能界定的是OXT作用的位置和时间：作用于接触的维持而非发起，且仅在主体新颖时，这一模式更符合基于显著性和新颖性的解释，而非联结形成。

papers.title: Reduced subcortical envelope phase locking in middle age without detectable changes in perceptual discrimination
papers.translated_title: 中年期皮层下包络相位锁定减弱，但知觉辨别无可检测变化
papers.author: Lopez-Ramos, D.
papers.summary: Cochlear synaptopathy (CS) can occur during normal aging without elevated audiometric thresholds and has been hypothesized to contribute to suprathreshold auditory difficulties. Frequency-following responses (FFRs) have been proposed as markers of CS, but whether their envelope- and temporal-fine-structure-related components are similarly affected by age, and whether such changes relate to perceptual sensitivity, remains unclear. Here, we examined associations between age-related FFR changes and perceptual sensitivity in young (n = 20, 19-32 years) and middle-aged (n = 20, 40-58 years) adults with clinically normal hearing. Participants completed psychoacoustic discrimination tasks for formant frequency, formant bandwidth, and temporal-envelope shape using stationary stimuli in quiet and background noise. FFRs were recorded using dynamic stimuli varying along the same acoustic dimensions. We quantified envelope- and temporal-fine-structure-related phase locking (PLVENV and PLVTFS) across harmonics and assessed how it tracked stimulus changes over time. Mean PLVENV decreased significantly with age, and PLVENV tracking of decreasing formant bandwidth and temporal-envelope shape weakened with age. In contrast, mean PLVTFS and temporal slopes of PLVTFS spectral centroid were not significantly associated with age. Discrimination thresholds showed no significant associations with age, either in quiet or in noise, and PLV measures did not significantly explain individual differences in discrimination thresholds. These findings indicate that age-related reductions in subcortical envelope phase locking can be detected by middle age without corresponding measurable reductions in perceptual sensitivity.
papers.translated_summary: 耳蜗突触病变（CS）可在正常衰老过程中发生，而不伴随听阈升高，并被认为可能导致超阈值听觉困难。频率跟随反应（FFR）已被提出作为CS的标志物，但其包络相关成分和时间精细结构相关成分是否同样受年龄影响，以及这些变化是否与感知敏感性相关，仍不清楚。在本研究中，我们考察了临床听力正常的年轻成人（n = 20，19-32岁）和中年成人（n = 20，40-58岁）中年龄相关FFR变化与感知敏感性之间的关联。参与者完成了针对共振峰频率、共振峰带宽和时间包络形状的心理声学辨别任务，使用安静和背景噪声中的稳态刺激。FFR使用沿相同声学维度变化的动态刺激记录。我们量化了跨谐波的包络相关和时间精细结构相关的相位锁定（PLVENV和PLVTFS），并评估其如何随时间追踪刺激变化。平均PLVENV随年龄显著下降，且PLVENV对递减共振峰带宽和时间包络形状的追踪随年龄减弱。相比之下，平均PLVTFS及PLVTFS频谱质心的时间斜率与年龄无显著关联。辨别阈值在安静或噪声条件下均未显示与年龄的显著关联，且PLV指标未能显著解释辨别阈值的个体差异。这些发现表明，亚皮层包络相位锁定的年龄相关下降可在中年被检测到，而不伴随可测量的感知敏感性相应下降。

papers.title: Terminally differentiated CX3CR1+ natural killer cells drive coronary arteritis through an NFAT-T-bet axis
papers.translated_title: 终末分化的CX3CR1+自然杀伤细胞通过NFAT-T-bet轴驱动冠状动脉炎
papers.author: Fujita, M.
papers.summary: Natural killer (NK) cells acquire potent effector function through terminal differentiation, yet the signals driving this program toward pathogenicity in vascular inflammation remain undefined. Using an FK565-induced mouse model of Kawasaki disease and single-cell transcriptomics from patients, we identify NK cells as major drivers of coronary arteritis through cytotoxicity and CCL5-CCR1-mediated recruitment of myeloid cells. This activity is concentrated in a terminally differentiated, T-bet-driven NK cell subset, the cardiac accumulation of which depends on CX3CR1, and a corresponding population is enriched in patient transcriptomic datasets. We further identify signaling through calcineurin and nuclear factor of activated T cells (NFAT) as an upstream driver of this program, with NFATc1 induced in NK cells. Calcineurin inhibition suppressed T-bet induction, reduced this subset and attenuated disease development. These findings define an NFAT-T-bet-CX3CR1 axis that couples terminal NK cell differentiation to coronary inflammation.
papers.translated_summary: 自然杀伤（NK）细胞通过终末分化获得强效效应功能，然而在血管炎症中驱动该程序走向致病性的信号仍不明确。利用FK565诱导的川崎病小鼠模型以及来自患者的单细胞转录组学，我们确定NK细胞是通过细胞毒作用以及CCL5-CCR1介导的髓系细胞募集来驱动冠状动脉炎的主要因素。该活性集中于一个终末分化的、由T-bet驱动的NK细胞亚群，其心脏蓄积依赖于CX3CR1，并且相应的人群在患者转录组数据集中富集。我们进一步确定通过钙调神经磷酸酶和活化T细胞核因子（NFAT）的信号传导是该程序的上游驱动因素，其中NFATc1在NK细胞中被诱导。钙调神经磷酸酶抑制抑制了T-bet诱导，减少了该亚群并减弱了疾病发展。这些发现定义了一个NFAT-T-bet-CX3CR1轴，将NK细胞终末分化与冠状动脉炎症偶联起来。

papers.title: Dynamic T-cell receptor repertoire remodeling is associated with murine and human lung allograft dysfunction
papers.translated_title: 动态T细胞受体库重塑与小鼠和人类肺移植功能障碍相关
papers.author: Wang, Y.
papers.summary: Chronic lung allograft dysfunction (CLAD) is a major cause of late graft failure after lung transplantation. Acute cellular rejection is an established risk factor for CLAD. However, its diagnosis by biopsy may incompletely capture dynamic and spatially heterogeneous immune remodeling within the allograft. We investigated whether lung graft proximal T-cell receptor beta-chain (TCR{beta}) repertoire features reflect alloimmune remodeling and associate with acute cellular rejection (ACR) and CLAD. TCR{beta}; sequencing was performed on graft-infiltrating T-cells from a murine orthotopic lung transplant model and on 90 longitudinal bronchoalveolar lavage cell-pellet (BAL-cp) samples from 23 lung transplant recipients during the first post-transplant year. In the murine model, allografts showed persistent histologic injury and strong, consistent TCR{beta}; repertoire remodeling relative to isografts. Across days 28 and 56, murine allografts had higher productive clonality (Cliff's {delta}; = 0.93, p = 0.0087) and maximum productive frequency (Cliff's {delta}; = 0.93, p = 0.014), with complete rank separation at each time point. Murine allografts also exhibited greater pairwise Morisita repertoire overlap (p < 0.0001) and enrichment of recurrent, high-frequency shared clonotypes. Productive clonality from human lung transplant recipients' BAL-cp was higher at the a priori selected month-6 visit from patients who developed CLAD, as compared to those who remained CLAD-free (p = 0.0326). In a month-6 surveillance-visit index analysis, high productive clonality was associated with early onset CLAD (CLAD within 2 years of transplant) (log-rank p = 0.038). In a patient-specific index-event analysis, CLAD-free survival differed across high and low productive clonality groups among acute rejectors (log-rank p = 0.019). Together, these findings establish measurable graft-localized TCR{beta}; repertoire remodeling and position BAL TCR{beta}; profiling as a potential complement to biopsy diagnosis. With validation in larger cohorts, graft-proximal repertoire measures may help identify CLAD-associated immune states before the onset of lung function decline and inform more individualized surveillance.
papers.translated_summary: 慢性肺移植物功能障碍（CLAD）是肺移植后晚期移植物衰竭的主要原因。急性细胞排斥反应是CLAD的既定危险因素。然而，通过活检诊断可能无法完全捕捉移植物内动态且空间异质性的免疫重塑。我们研究了肺移植物近端T细胞受体β链（TCR{beta}） repertoire特征是否反映同种免疫重塑，并与急性细胞排斥反应（ACR）和CLAD相关。对小鼠原位肺移植模型的移植物浸润T细胞以及23名肺移植受者移植后第一年内90份纵向支气管肺泡灌洗细胞沉淀（BAL-cp）样本进行了TCR{beta}测序。在小鼠模型中，与同种移植物相比，同种异体移植物显示出持续的组织学损伤和强烈、一致的TCR{beta} repertoire重塑。在第28天和第56天，小鼠同种异体移植物具有更高的生产性克隆性（Cliff's {delta} = 0.93，p = 0.0087）和最大生产性频率（Cliff's {delta} = 0.93，p = 0.014），在每个时间点均具有完全的秩分离。小鼠同种异体移植物还表现出更大的成对Morisita repertoire重叠（p < 0.0001）以及复发性高频共享克隆型的富集。与保持无CLAD的患者相比，发展为CLAD的患者在预先选择的第6个月访视时，人肺移植受者BAL-cp的生产性克隆性更高（p = 0.0326）。在第6个月监测访视指数分析中，高生产性克隆性与早发性CLAD（移植后2年内发生CLAD）相关（log-rank p = 0.038）。在患者特异性指数事件分析中，急性排斥者中高和低生产性克隆性组的无CLAD生存率存在差异（log-rank p = 0.019）。总之，这些发现确立了可测量的移植物局部TCR{beta} repertoire重塑，并将BAL TCR{beta}谱分析定位为活检诊断的潜在补充。随着在更大队列中的验证，移植物近端repertoire测量可能有助于在肺功能下降发生之前识别与CLAD相关的免疫状态，并为更个体化的监测提供信息。

papers.title: A Conserved Interface Between COG4 and Syntaxin 5 Is Essential for Intra-Golgi Membrane Trafficking
papers.translated_title: COG4与Syntaxin 5之间一个保守的界面对于高尔基体内膜运输至关重要
papers.author: Neetole, S. T.
papers.summary: The conserved oligomeric Golgi (COG) complex tethers retrograde intra-Golgi transport vesicles, but how it engages the SNARE machinery to support vesicle fusion remains unclear. Here, we identify a functional interface between the COG subunit COG4 and the Qa-SNARE Syntaxin 5 (STX5). The C-terminal region of COG4 coprecipitated with STX5, and AlphaFold3 modeling placed the COG4 MUN-C-like subdomain in contact with the STX5 Ha-Hb loop and the linker connecting its Habc domain to the SNARE motif. Replacing the Ha-Hb loop with a flexible Gly/Ser sequence preserved STX5 localization and its interaction with SCFD1 but impaired rescue of GPP130 abundance and protein glycosylation in STX5-depleted cells. Combining the loop replacement with linker substitutions reduced recovery of COG3 and the SNARE partner GS15 with STX5 and led to vesicle accumulation around disorganized Golgi cisternae. On the COG4 side of the interface with Qa-SNARE, alanine substitution of the conserved residues D452 and D453 reduced coprecipitation with STX5. Replacing these residues with either alanine or lysine preserved COG4 localization and COG8 recruitment to the Golgi but failed to restore normal glycosylation, GS15 localization, or altered Golgi morphology in COG4-knockout cells. These findings support a model in which the COG4-STX5 interface couples vesicle tethering to productive SNARE assembly, thereby controlling vesicular retrograde trafficking and Golgi organization.
papers.translated_summary: 保守寡聚高尔基体（COG）复合体将逆向高尔基体内运输囊泡系连，但其如何与SNARE机制接合以支持囊泡融合仍不清楚。在此，我们鉴定了COG亚基COG4与Qa-SNARE Syntaxin 5（STX5）之间的功能性界面。COG4的C端区域与STX5共沉淀，AlphaFold3建模显示COG4的MUN-C样亚结构域与STX5的Ha-Hb环以及连接其Habc结构域与SNARE基序的连接区相接触。将Ha-Hb环替换为柔性Gly/Ser序列可保持STX5定位及其与SCFD1的相互作用，但削弱了在STX5缺失细胞中对GPP130丰度和蛋白质糖基化的挽救。将环替换与连接区替换相结合，降低了COG3和SNARE伙伴GS15与STX5的回收，并导致囊泡在紊乱的高尔基体扁平囊周围积累。在与Qa-SNARE界面的COG4一侧，保守残基D452和D453的丙氨酸替换降低了与STX5的共沉淀。将这些残基替换为丙氨酸或赖氨酸均保持了COG4定位及COG8向高尔基体的募集，但未能恢复COG4敲除细胞中的正常糖基化、GS15定位或改变的高尔基体形态。这些发现支持一个模型，即COG4-STX5界面将囊泡系连与有效的SNARE组装偶联，从而控制囊泡逆向运输和高尔基体组织。

papers.title: Physical constraints on the social-genetic dynamics of mtDNA inside plant mitochondria
papers.translated_title: 植物线粒体内mtDNA社会-遗传动力学的物理约束
papers.author: Chustecki, J. M.
papers.summary: Mitochondrial DNA (mtDNA) encodes essential cellular machinery and is contained within mitochondria. This physical containment shapes the genetic dynamics of mtDNA populations in the cell. In plants (and other non-bilaterians), mtDNA colocalisation is essential for recombination, while other cellular priorities may favour mtDNA spacing through the cell. Given possible physical interactions between mtDNA and the inner mitochondrial membrane and its cristae, it is not clear how readily or often this colocalisation may occur. Only limited, indirect evidence exists supporting the capacity for plant mtDNAs to physically colocalise. Here, we survey evidence from recent and new single-cell timelapse microscopy to quantitatively characterise the motion of mtDNA nucleoids inside vegetative plant cells. We combine biophysical arguments with new microscopy data and spatial statistics to demonstrate the subdiffusive but not internally static nature of nucleoids, demonstrating that they are enriched at the termini of elongated mitochondria and well-spaced through the cell but capable of colocalisation. We also describe other modes of physical motion that may impact the genetic dynamics of mtDNA populations, and discuss the implication of this physical behaviour for cytoplasmic genetics.
papers.translated_summary: 线粒体DNA（mtDNA）编码必需的细胞机器并存在于线粒体内部。这种物理上的封闭塑造了细胞中mtDNA群体的遗传动态。在植物（以及其他非两侧对称动物）中，mtDNA的共定位对于重组至关重要，而其他细胞优先事项可能有利于mtDNA在细胞中的间隔分布。鉴于mtDNA与线粒体内膜及其嵴之间可能存在物理相互作用，这种共定位可能发生的方式和频率尚不清楚。目前仅有有限的间接证据支持植物mtDNA能够发生物理共定位。在此，我们综述了来自近期和新的单细胞延时显微成像的证据，以定量表征营养期植物细胞中mtDNA拟核的运动。我们将生物物理学论证与新的显微数据和空间统计相结合，证明拟核具有亚扩散性但并非内部静止的特性，表明它们富集于 elongated mitochondria 的末端并在细胞中良好间隔分布，但能够发生共定位。我们还描述了其他可能影响mtDNA群体遗传动态的物理运动模式，并讨论了这种物理行为对细胞质遗传学的意义。
